description:
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast a copy of Seething Song by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Choreographed Sparks by paying {R}{R}, copying the Seething Song and Pinnacle Monk spells.
Resolve the copy of the Pinnacle Monk spell. When the token copy enters, it triggers, returning Choreographed Sparks from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of the Seething Song spell, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
